I need help regarding two tickets below.

"The liquid cooling cable is dripping on the Sicharge D charger (details below), we'd like to replace it. It was already replaced once this year. Is it possible to replace it with a different kind? That doesn't have this dripping problem.
Please, suggest replace part number(s)."

additional_info.subject: ID0467654-DC/Si-D/HU-[Multi] Power Converter(5) Issue CRM:03275000001
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0467654
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-HU SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
RVP/T7170004940
Charger ID / Serial No.:
TITvWA
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:  Following the procedure for diagnosing a power converter issue, and after our check, we can see that converter number 5 is faulty.
First, check the cables attached to that converter. If they are properly connected, proceed to the next step.
Try swapping the converter that shows the issue with the one beside it. This will help confirm whether the problem lies in the cables or in the converter itself. If the issue remains after swapping, it confirms that the converter itself is faulty. In that case,
replace the converter:
-8EM5903-0AA04-7AA5
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-HU SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Anass Mezzaoui
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
